features: Deep learning-based motion detection 2.0 for all analog channels
Deep learning-based face picture comparison (1-ch for HD analog camera), up to 16 libraries with up to 500 face pictures
Deep learning-based perimeter protection: human/vehicle analysis up to 4-ch
Face picture comparison, motion detection 2.0 and perimeter protection cannot be enabled at the same time
notes: Datasheet IP video input: 2-ch (up to 6-ch); Enhanced IP mode on: 4-ch (up to 8-ch), each up to 4 Mbps; Up to 8 MP resolution.
Datasheet states that Enhanced IP mode may conflict with smart events or other functions.
